prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1155; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured states the other vehicle drifted into their lane while they were signaling. Initial contact made with the claimant, who reports a back strain and some stiffness in the lower back. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has not yet provided a statement.

Entry 2: Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant. They describe a sharp jolt to the torso when the vehicles made contact, followed by pain in the lower back that worsened over the next several hours. Claimant has not yet seen a physician and is considering a visit. Advised claimant of the medical documentation process and the option to seek care from their own provider.

Entry 3: Scene photos and the police report have been obtained. Damage is visible on the driver side rear quarter panel of the insured vehicle and the passenger side front fender of the claimant vehicle, consistent with a glancing contact. Witness statement pending. Liability appears to lean toward the other driver based on the available evidence, but this remains under review.

Entry 4: Claimant contacted the office to report that they have now been evaluated by an urgent care provider. Diagnosis listed as a lumbar strain with a recommendation for rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and follow-up if symptoms persist. Requested itemized medical records and billing. Claimant has not indicated any intent to retain legal counsel at this time.

Entry 5: Reviewed the file with the supervisor. Liability assessment remains pending the witness statement. Medical records received and under review. Scheduled a follow-up call with the claimant to check on symptoms and confirm the treatment plan. Reserve will be revisited once the medical picture is clearer. File remains open.
